messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The SP / PU / GO request changes to the MPO or the MPO himself causes a change. The MPO reviews the change request. The MPO rejects the change of the measuring point by the SP / PU / GO or the MPO confirmes the request of the SP / PU / GO. The MPO performs the measuring point change. The MPO reports the implementation to the SP / PU / GO or notifies the SP / PU / GO about the failure of the changes.

response.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="MeasuringPointChangeProcess" name="Measuring Point Change Process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestOrInitiation" name="SP/PU/GO Request or MPO Initiation">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewChangeRequest" name="MPO Reviews Change Request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision" name="Decision on Change">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reject</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Confirm</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Change Rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reject</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PerformChange" name="MPO Performs Measuring Point Change">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Confirm</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Result" name="Result of Implementation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Success</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Failure</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReportSuccess" name="MPO Reports Implementation to SP/PU/GO">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Success</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyFailure" name="MPO Notifies SP/PU/GO about Failure">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Failure</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Success" name="Process Completed (Success)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Failure" name="Process Completed (Failure)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestOrInitiation" targetRef="Task_ReviewChangeRequest" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_ReviewChangeRequest" targetRef="Gateway_Decision" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reject" name="Reject" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirm" name="Confirm" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="Task_PerformChange" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_PerformChange" targetRef="Gateway_Result" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Success" name="Success" sourceRef="Gateway_Result" targetRef="Task_ReportSuccess" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Failure" name="Failure" sourceRef="Gateway_Result" targetRef="Task_NotifyFailure" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_ReportSuccess" targetRef="EndEvent_Success" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_NotifyFailure" targetRef="EndEvent_Failure" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
